cards.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
cards.summaryOriginal: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator. cards.summaryEn: DreamX-Creator 1.0 is a 7B native joint audio-video generation system that denoises specialized audio and video streams simultaneously for better synchronization.

cards.title: Super Library Agent: Joint Generation and Maintenance of Multiple Applications Beyond the Single Codebase
cards.summaryOriginal: Organizations often develop and maintain portfolios of related applications: independently deployable codebases that share substantial domain logic, interface patterns, or operational conventions. cards.summaryEn: Super Library Agent explores joint generation and maintenance workflows for portfolios of related applications to reduce code duplication in multi-app projects.

cards.reasonEn: Addresses multi-codebase agentic software maintenance challenges.

cards.title: Evaluating the Hidden Costs of Personalization in Large Language Models
cards.summaryOriginal: While Large language models (LLMs) incorporate user personalization signals to improve usability and helpfulness, they increasingly shift from providing balanced, informative responses toward optimizing for user satisfaction when conditioned on personal context such as conversation history, inferred preferences, and user profiles. Specifically, we identify three emerging risks: (1) irrelevant per…
cards.summaryEn: Research paper analyzing the hidden risks of LLM personalization, showing how satisfying user context can degrade balanced and informative responses.

cards.reasonEn: Highlights emerging risks in LLM personalization behaviors.
cards.reasonKo: LLM 개인화 동작에서 새롭게 부상하는 위험 강조.

cards.title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
cards.summaryOriginal: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. Modern vision-language models (VLMs) already encode spatial priors for visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and pointing, but these capabilities are rarely elicited directly for robot control. Existing navigation systems instead rely on task-…
cards.summaryEn: LightNav-0 leverages vision-language models for robot spatial intelligence, directly applying VLM spatial priors to generalist embodied navigation tasks.

cards.title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions
cards.summaryOriginal: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. cards.summaryEn: A study on strategic deception in multi-agent vision-language model systems using social-deduction games to evaluate joint verbal and non-verbal deception.

cards.title: Sliding-window beats linear attention
cards.summaryOriginal: Due to the nature of quadratic attention, Large Language Models (LLMs) consume a lot of memory and energy. Every new token costs more than the previous one. cards.summaryEn: Explores how sliding-window attention overcomes the quadratic scaling bottlenecks of traditional large language model memory usage.

cards.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
cards.summaryOriginal: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. cards.summaryEn: Enhances Vision-Language-Action models by distilling behavior intent rather than relying solely on direct motor command cloning.

cards.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
cards.summaryOriginal: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. cards.title: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
cards.summaryOriginal: Generative models can turn natural-language prompts into images, text, code, and other content, lowering the cost of producing drafts and components. cards.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
cards.summaryOriginal: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. cards.summaryEn: Presents a retrieval and tuning method to improve multi-turn tool-calling capabilities in autonomous agents.

cards.title: Locate Anything in Videos: Rethinking Efficient Generative Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
cards.summaryOriginal: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) requires models to identify when a referred event occurs and localize the target entity throughout that interval. Existing multimodal large language models typically serialize dense localization trajectories autoregressively, causing decoding latency to grow with tube length and allowing localization errors to propagate across time. cards.summaryEn: Proposes a parallel method for efficient generative spatio-temporal video grounding to reduce decoding latency.

cards.title: LayerRecall: A State-Conditioned Memory Router for Long-Horizon Consistency in Video Generation
cards.summaryOriginal: Autoregressive video diffusion enables scalable long-video generation by producing chunks from a bounded recent context.
